Minkyung · Listen & Shadow 10

The One You'd Never Buy — overrated, saying no, honest but not rude
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · OVERRATED
👤 Brian
What's overrated right now?
요즘 과대평가된 게 뭐예요?
overrated — 실제보다 높게 평가된
💬 Minkyung
It's just not worth the price.
그 값은 아니에요.
worth the price — 값어치를 하다
같은 패턴으로 — It's not worth the wait. · It's not worth the trip.
💬 Minkyung
You're paying for the name.
이름값을 내는 거죠.
pay for the name — 브랜드값을 내다
같은 패턴으로 — You're paying for the packaging. · You're paying for the location.
💬 Minkyung
It looks better than it wears.
보기엔 좋은데 막상 쓰면 아니에요.
wear — (옷·물건이) 쓰이다, 견디다
같은 패턴으로 — It looks better than it tastes. · It photographs better than it looks.
💬 Minkyung
I'd put that money into a coat instead.
그 돈이면 저는 차라리 코트에 쓰겠어요.
put money into ~ — ~에 돈을 쓰다 · instead — 대신
같은 패턴으로 — I'd put that money into shoes instead. · I'd put it into a trip instead.
PART 2 · SAYING NO
👤 Brian
Have you ever turned down a brand?
브랜드 협찬을 거절해본 적 있어요?
turn down — 거절하다
💬 Minkyung
I'd pass on that one.
저는 그건 안 할게요.
pass on ~ — ~는 안 하다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd pass on the dessert. · I'd pass on that offer.
💬 Minkyung
It's not the right fit for me.
저랑은 잘 안 맞아요.
the right fit — 잘 맞는 것
같은 패턴으로 — It's not the right fit for my channel. · She wasn't the right fit for the role.
💬 Minkyung
I didn't feel comfortable with that product.
그 제품은 마음이 편치 않았어요.
feel comfortable with ~ — ~가 마음 편하다
같은 패턴으로 — I didn't feel comfortable with the wording. · I don't feel comfortable saying that.
💬 Minkyung
Thanks for thinking of me, but I'll have to pass this time.
생각해주셔서 감사한데, 이번엔 어렵겠어요.
think of someone — 떠올려주다 · pass — 이번엔 안 하다
같은 패턴으로 — Thanks for the offer, but not this time. · Thanks for asking — maybe next round.
PART 3 · HONEST, NOT RUDE
👤 Brian
How do you say it's not worth it without being rude?
무례하지 않게 별로라고 어떻게 말해요?
rude — 무례한
💬 Minkyung
It's beautiful, but the price is the problem.
예쁘긴 한데, 값이 문제예요.
the problem — 문제되는 점
같은 패턴으로 — It's beautiful, but it's heavy. · He's good, but he's late every time.
💬 Minkyung
It's a great product — just not for everyday use.
좋은 제품이에요 — 다만 매일 쓸 분들껜 아니고요.
just not for ~ — 다만 ~에는 아닌
같은 패턴으로 — It's a great bag — just not for travel. · Great film — just not for kids.
💬 Minkyung
I can see why people love it, but it's not for me.
왜 좋아하는지는 알겠는데, 저는 아니에요.
I can see why ~ — 왜 ~인지 알겠다
같은 패턴으로 — I can see why it sold out. · I can see why she left.
💬 Minkyung
That's just my take.
제 생각일 뿐이에요.
my take — 내 생각, 내 관점
같은 패턴으로 — That's just my take on it. · What's your take?
느리게 15/15 · 보통 15/15
